items.html: *And the essence of this drop of the Tzelem is formed from the upper KHB, when they are clothed and included in the Hochma and the second Tevuna. And this Tzelem is formed there in the womb of this second Tevuna, which is the first Tevuna, as above. And at the time of the birth, this Tzelem comes out of her womb, and clothes within the second Tevuna, which is the third; and there it is called the Tzelem of ZA, as will be said, God willing. And we shall first explain these Mochin themselves, and afterwards we shall explain the phase that makes them a Tzelem.
